proposal:
BDP: bidirectional Davis-Putnam at the root. STATUS: unimplemented and unexecuted; every trace below is a hand derivation from the supplied code.

DIAGNOSIS. The Neon58 quotient is the full distributive expansion of G = (OR_i ~p_i)(OR_j ~q_j) AND_ij (p_i v q_j) with p_i = a_i v c_i. By hand trace, pinned ELIM decides G without branching (eliminating p_1 turns k+1 clauses into k, and so on). In the expansion each a_i has k positive and 2^(k-1) negative occurrences, so every elimination grows and ELIM is STUCK. The pinned solver only walks downhill along DP elimination; the expansion is a local minimum that the inverse move leaves.

RULE GRID (sound, restricted). Let A be a set of >=2 literals and D a nonempty set of clauses avoiding var(A), with (l v d) in F for all l in A, d in D. Replace those |A||D| clauses by (x v l) and (~x v d), x fresh. Then F(s) <=> exists x F'(s,x) for every assignment s to the old variables. This is one distributive identity, the exact converse of `attempt(F',x)`. It is a projection equivalence like DP, not merely equisatisfiable. It reads only the grid's clauses, so no extra clause can invalidate it. Certificate per step: (x,A,D), checked for freshness, x-occurrences and grid membership in time linear in the grid. This is bounded variable addition (Manthey-Heule-Biere 2012; SBVA 2023; recalled, not re-verified), not new mathematics.

GUARD AND POTENTIAL. Accept GRID only if (clauses m, literals L) strictly decreases lexicographically. Run ONE sweep at the root, then pinned canon/SCC/IALH/ELIM with one change: a fresh x may be eliminated only if m strictly drops (no-undo). The sweep has at most L0 steps and adds at most L0 variables; ELIM then makes at most n0+L0 eliminations. Discovery: hash each clause minus one literal (L keys of <=w literals), take literal pairs sharing >=2 remainders, grow A greedily, and skip beyond a pair budget. Bit work: O(L0^2 w log n) with naive rehashing, plus pinned ELIM at (n0+L0) steps x n candidates x O(m^2 w log n) per `attempt`+canon. This is polynomial for the root phase only; nothing bounds residual search.

TRACE ON THE k-PAIR FAMILY (N about k*2^k bits). Per side the sweep finds k-1 grids of sizes 2x2^(k-1),...,2x2 (the last keeps m and lowers L). That leaves (x_i v ~a_i),(x_i v ~c_i) for i<k and two clauses (~x_1..~x_(k-1) v ~a_k), (same v ~c_k): 4k+k^2 clauses in total. Every original variable now has one negative occurrence, so each elimination replaces k+1 clauses by k. After all 4k, k^2 clauses remain: (x_i v y_j),(x_i v ~Y),(y_j v ~X),(~X v ~Y). Eliminating x_1 replaces 2k clauses by k after subsumption, and the chain ends in units y_j against ~Y. Independent-test prediction: UNSAT at root, peak 0, for k=3..7 (k=7 has 28 variables and 305 clauses, inside the contract).

GUARD CONFLICT. Under the pinned clause-count guard without no-undo, a fresh x has occurrence product 2x2=4 and its elimination is clause-neutral, hence accepted. For k=4 originals also have product 4 and win ties by lower id, so the trace survives. For k>=5 I predict x is eliminated first, re-expanding its grid, and the root is STUCK. One test separates the two guards.

EXTRAS. A clause containing a_i positively only weakens to (x_i v E) and blocks nothing. A clause (~a_i v E) without its twin (~c_i v E) leaves the grids intact but gives a_i two negative occurrences; its elimination yields 2k clauses for k+2 and is rejected. That DP guard, not factoring, is the exact remaining obstruction. Each blocked gate still needs a branch, and I have no bound better than 2^t for t of them.

AUDIT (read-through only). The compression verifier builds blocks from every original clause and checks all local points, form supports and every P*L entry. I found no soundness gap there or in the subset gate of `probe`. On Neon58 both probes should return no_clauses_removed, consistent with the report. Cost defects: `step` caches on the pre-canon state, so equal canonical formulas re-run `refute` (consistent with 4 of 12 repeats). `refute` also runs before `elim_plus` at every node, spending up to 8192 full-formula UP runs even where ELIM alone decides. Running ELIM first and IALH only on STUCK is exact and leaves the layers unchanged.
missing_theorem:
(A) Small, wants Lean: the GRID identity [for all s: AND_{l,d}(l v d) <=> exists x (AND_l (x v l) AND AND_d (~x v d))], its composition with DP projection, and the step bound 2*L0+n0 under the no-undo guard.

(B) Restricted collapse (sketch, unproved). Let F be the full distributive expansion of a CNF G under p_i = OR of >=2 literals on disjoint variable sets, plus arbitrary extra clauses in which gate variables occur only positively. Then every maximal guarded sweep leaves each gate either factored or with a single negative clause. Guarded ELIM removes all gate variables with m strictly decreasing. The result is G with p_i renamed (some already DP-eliminated) plus weakened extras, within the stated work. Open inside (B): whether the subsequent ELIM order decides whenever ELIM decides G. DP order-independence is only finitely tested (`all_admissible`).

(C) The real gap. Call F monotone-decidable if SOME sequence of GRID(s) and DP moves, non-increasing in (m,L), reaches SAT or the empty clause. Here s is the maximal sub-clause size on the A side: s=1 above, and s up to 4 would be needed for bent gates, at about m*w^s keys. Such a sequence is a polynomial certificate. Needed: a canonical polynomial-time strategy deciding every monotone-decidable F, or a counterexample. I expect a counterexample, because maximal bicliques overlap and maximum-biclique selection is NP-hard. Falsification target: the pairwise at-most-one cliques inside pigeonhole h=3 (12 variables). Enumerate all maximal sweeps exhaustively and compare outcomes.

(D) Not conjectured: that monotone-decidable formulas include all CNFs, or that t blocked gates cost fewer than 2^t states. Random 3-CNF at linear density has, with high probability, no 2x2 literal grid, and after the few low-occurrence eliminations ELIM already performs, no non-increasing elimination. BDP is the identity there and adds only O(L w log n) wasted work. Any all-CNF bound must come from a different invariant.
self_attack:
1. GRID is known preprocessing (BVA). The contribution is integration, the potential shared with the pinned DP guard, and the guard-conflict prediction. None of it is a new theorem.
2. Every trace is by hand. The k=4 survival under the pinned guard rests on one tie-break (`ranks` by id). The k>=5 failure prediction could be wrong in either direction. Earlier hand predictions in this project were repeatedly wrong.
3. The no-undo rule changes ELIM only for fresh variables, but the sweep changes every downstream state: supports, IALH windows, min-product choices. New binary clauses sort first in `windows`. With max_windows=256 and max_rows=128 they can displace windows that currently give root refutations, turning them into UNKNOWN (sound, slower). A pinned-path fallback at most doubles work but must be measured.
4. Fresh variables break the order contract: `run_counting_core` demands order == variables. Root-only deployment must append them explicitly. Applying GRID inside `step` would leave undecided residuals and raise.
5. The Lean chain proves exact equivalence through linear quotients. GRID needs a projection lemma and separate receipts. Composing it after compression is unverified.
6. Greedy grid choice is not confluent. Grid members removed by canon when an extra subsumes them shrink the grid. A subsumption-tolerant membership test is exact but unanalysed.
7. Nothing here lowers the pigeonhole IALH cost, and more binary clauses may raise it.
8. Negative-side extras restore branching with no bound. Kernel-free families (expander Tseitin, bent-gate compositions at s=1, random CNF) are untouched. This is a restricted repair, not progress toward a general polynomial algorithm.
9. Peak 0 is not low work: pinned `attempt` forms all pos x neg resolvents before testing the guard.
mechanism_signature: BDP: one root sweep of literal-grid variable addition (inverse DP, exact existential projection, strict lexicographic decrease of (clauses, literals)), then pinned SCC/IALH/ELIM with a no-undo guard on fresh variables. Certificate per step = (x, A, D), checked by the distributive identity. Step bound 2*L0+n0; no residual-search bound.
delta_from_prior: Fable73's twin contraction and my WRD(t) both need a global property (identical links, residual dominance) that one asymmetric clause destroys, and WRD is only equisatisfiable. BDP differs in four checkable ways. (1) It is local to a biclique of clauses and exact under projection, so no extra can invalidate a step. (2) It has an explicit step bound, 2*L0+n0, from a potential shared with the pinned DP guard. (3) It relocates the Neon58 obstruction from missing symmetry to the DP guard on negative-side extras; positive-side extras are harmless in the sketch. (4) It yields a new falsifiable prediction about the pinned code: clause-neutral additions are undone by the pinned guard for k>=5 but not for k=4. Also new: the ELIM-before-IALH reordering. Not repeated: fibre-cardinality semantics, core mining, link-twin detection.
